contents_summary: One Word document with two tables: Table 1 normal reference ranges for ten basic laboratory components (population intervals, no patient data) and Table 2, a day-by-day event timeline for Patients 1, 2 and 3 (hospital days 0 to 10) covering presentation, intubation, proning, organ complications, complete heart block, pacing, resuscitation, comfort measures, death and transfer.

Components | Normal reference range

blocks.contents: Table 2 title, a header row (Days of Hospitalization | Event), and per-patient day-labelled event rows for Patient 1 (units 17-21), Patient 2 (units 23-29) and Patient 3 (units 31-36), each preceded by a Patient heading row.
blocks.clinical_relevance_notes: Patient headings in units 16, 22 and 30 own the rows that follow them; every event row is day-labelled.
